opinions.text:

C. A. 1st Cir. [Certiorari granted, 543 U. S. 1144.] Motion of the Solicitor General for leave to participate in oral argument as amicus curiae and for divided argument granted. Motion of IBP, Inc., and Barber Foods, Inc., for divided argument denied. Motion of respondents Avarez et al. for divided argument denied.
